notes.title: "Two Hundred Ways" on PC got an update
notes.notes:
Today, Sunlight Games has released an update for “Two Hundred Ways” on Steam for PC. The update brings performance and design improvements as well as the possibility to enlarge the HUD up to 200%.

"Two Hundred Ways" has been available for PC, Xbox One Consoles and Xbox Series X|S and will be released soon for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and for Nintendo Switch™.

notes.title: "Two Hundred Ways" got an update
notes.notes:
Today, Sunlight Games has released an update for “Two Hundred Ways” on Steam. The update fixes small problems that occurs with the use of a few monitors and brings performance improvements.

“Two Hundred Ways” will be released as well soon for Xbox One Consoles, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and for Nintendo Switch™.

Changelog 1.0.5
- Settings like language, hud scaling, sound & music volume will not longer be saved in the registry but now in the save-file in the install directory. All other settings will still be saved in the registry
- The hz number will be set and saved automatically, based on the chosen display hz number
- The bug in level 56 is fixed. It happened on a few displays who were set with more than 60hz
- A few levels got a minor changes
- Minor fixes
- Performance improvements

notes.title: “Two Hundred Ways” Release-Livestream!
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle fans!
We are happy, that “Two Hundred Ways” will be released on 3rd of September on Steam.
On the release day, we will broadcast a livestream on the Steam Store Page, showing parts of the game and answer chat questions.
See features, gameplay and some tips from the developers.

The livestream will start at 8pm CEST (Germany), 2pm EST (New York).

See you then!

Thanks to all!

notes.title: Release date of "Two Hundred Ways" for PC announced
notes.notes:
Today, Sunlight Games has announced the release date of “Two Hundred Ways” for PC. The game will be released on Steam on 03rd September 2021.
“Two Hundred Ways” will be released as well soon for Xbox One Consoles, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and for Nintendo Switch™.

"One Hundred Ways" presented 100 puzzle challenges to players: they had to steer a ball to its goal. And that was not always as easy as it might sound. "Two Hundred Ways" ups the ante and doubles the number of levels. More than 40 logic-based tools will help players to guide the ball on its correct path. Several tutorial levels help players to get a grip on how to use them and how to play the addictive puzzle game.
